theme.title: The Sunken Meridian
theme.setting: A drowned trade-road of reef towns and tide-locked ruins, descending current by current toward the luminous trench where the old line ends.

theme.flavor: The tide keeps its own ledgers here.

tasks.name: Ride the Current to The Glassy Meridian

theme.flavor: Whatever sank here learned to grow.

tasks.name: Ride the Current to The Moonlit Ruins

theme.flavor: The current has opinions about your route.

tasks.name: Ride the Current to the Luminous Trench

perks.name: Deepwater Sight
perks.tooltip: Unlocks the automation system (engine + UI gates).

perks.name: Pearled Blood
perks.tooltip: +50 max energy, applied once when the perk is granted (tryAddPerk).

perks.name: Fathomless Grip
perks.tooltip: Enables attunement gain (calcAttunementGain returns 0 without it).

perks.name: Barnacle Instinct
perks.tooltip: Energy drain scaled by zone-completion history (calcReflectionsOnTheJourneyMult).

perks.name: Barnacle Lungs
perks.tooltip: Max energy grows each reset by (current_zone+1) * ENERGETIC_MEMORY_MULT.

perks.name: Coldproof Lungs
perks.tooltip: Task speed and drain x MAJOR_TIME_COMPRESSION_EFFECT; single-tick tasks complete all reps in one tick.

perks.name: Anchored Song
perks.tooltip: Keep half of each item stack (rounded up) across energy resets; enables the prep-run hint.
